inputs.input: "Coming in," I say, and walk through the gate into the city.
I head uphill to the Guild hall and look for a reception desk or notice board.
I go to the middle window. "Good morning. I'd like to register with the Guild, and hear what work is available for a new mage."
"I'm paying," I say, and count out two silver.
I go through the ajar door to the members' board and look over the catacomb culling postings.

I take the tallow delivery slip and the catacomb clearing slip, and bring both back to the clerk. "I'd like to take these two — they're both at the ruined chapel, so I can do the delivery and the clearing in one trip."
"Off to Bram's," I say, and head out to find the chandlery on Low Street.
"I'll take the handcart," I say, and hand over the two copper deposit.
I take the cart's shafts and start hauling west toward the gate, watching for the low, wet stretch Bram warned about.
I wheel the cart around to the back of the hut, following the sound of the axe. "Keeper Odo? Tallow delivery from Bram's."
"No message from Bram. Delivery's done — who do I tell it's complete, or will the Guild clerk hear it from you?"
I stack the crates back onto the handcart. "I'll carry them down for you — second door on the left, you said? Show me the way."

quest.carry_the_wardens_tinctures_to_hol.task: Deliver Vell's crate of fever tinctures to the Hollowbrook hamlet healer before the fever there spreads further; the hamlet road crosses open heath where a feral dog pack has been worrying travelers.

The crate waits behind the counter at the dispensary on Lamp Row, corded shut with a paper tag; the apothecary will bring it to the door once Alaric says it is the Hollowbrook crate.
The healer at the Hollowbrook cottage is Reeda, an old woman. Tell her the fever dose is the tall jar, four stoppers in the straw, and that Vell says the tall jar goes by the spoon, not the mouthful.
Route: out the south gate of Alderwatch, past the osier beds, then the heath. Dogs have been at the drover's cart near the standing stone — mind past there.

inputs.input: I pick Arcane Bolt and Focused Ward.
I walk along the road toward Alderwatch's gate.
I approach a stall vendor and ask for directions to the Adventurers' Guild.
I follow her directions up the street toward the well and the fork, keeping left to find the hall with crossed swords over the door.
I step over the worn threshold and go to the counter to register with the Guild.
"Alaric Red." I place two silver on the counter.
"Alaric Red." I drop two silver into the fee box's slot.
Registered — I take the plate and walk to the Novice board to see what contracts are posted.
I take the tincture slip to the clerk. "The Hollowbrook delivery, please—make that one active for me."
I head south to Lamp Row and find Apothecary Vell's dispensary to pick up the tincture crate.
"It's the Hollowbrook crate," I say. "I'll carry it to the healer intact."
I take the crate and head out the south gate toward Hollowbrook, minding the road past the standing stone.
